57	     the answer key; the measurement this workflow exists to support
58	     depends on that not happening. If the Work's task identifies such a

70	   workflow's own outcome is bounded by what each stage's `CONTEXT.md`

100	What was checked: <what you looked at before concluding it's ambiguous>

111	reconciliation-method.md` §3) — the workflow's current grammar has no
112	actor-initiated "ask a human mid-run" primitive, which is real signal, not
